summary: Etsy shows people pay $9–$45 for pet wanted posters and cards, but review counts are not sales and ChatGPT does the pet-persona trick free. There is no channel, no named buyer, and the Oct–Dec window would be mostly gone after a test plus a build.

demand.evidence: Etsy listings $9.25–$45 with 236 and 1.9k reviews, but reviews are not units. CardMyDog launched May 2026 with 6 upvotes and no reviews. The ChatGPT pet-to-person trend shows love of the joke and a free substitute. No one has paid or asked for it.

statusQuo.evidence: Etsy sellers (slow, one format), Adobe Express DIY, or a free ChatGPT image. The paid workaround isn't painful; the free one is viral.

specificity.evidence: Target is 'dog or cat owners who share pet content' and gift buyers: a category. No named person, no consequence; a vanity/gift purchase.

wedge.evidence: One photo, one alter ego, $9 unlock, no image model is small. Docked because the PRD bundles four templates, six alter egos and a share loop before the first sale.

futureFit.evidence: Image models and assistants keep getting free and better; the text moat is any free model; templates are cloneable in a weekend.

premises: Owners pay $9 for a finished bundle although ChatGPT does the image free (unsupported)
Comedy and story, not art, is what people pay for (unproven)
A watermarked share loop brings buyers without ads (plausible, unproven)
Etsy review counts imply real sales volume (weak)
The Oct–Dec gift season helps (true, but the test window is short)
alternatives: Hand-made concierge test: landing page plus $9 pay button, David makes the first 5 bundles by hand
Full self-serve preview/unlock generator as in the PRD
Add a pet template to giftlet instead of a new product
Sell a printable template pack on Etsy or Gumroad
wedge: One 'Wanted: your dog' poster with an AI-written rap sheet, free watermarked preview, $9 clean download.

feasibility.notes: Next.js, HTML/CSS templates, one free-model call via LiteLLM, JSON validation. M1 is $0; paying (M3) needs Stripe and a commercial-use host. Proving test: POST /generate for Biscuit/dog/crime boss returns 200 with alias, 3+ rap-sheet items and five 1–99 stats; invalid model output returns 502 and stores nothing.

risks: Sales volume unproven; Etsy shows reviews, not units
No ad-free channel; pet communities restrict promotion
Short seasonal window and easy copycats
Photo upload hosting, takedown and deletion duties
No founder fit in David's interests
killCriteria: Fewer than 5 paid $9 orders from the first 100 visitors or outreach contacts in 30 days; buyers say they would just use ChatGPT; or preview share rate stays under 10%.
